verdict.rationale: Persistent network storage is a fair question for a serverless GPU cloud platform like Modal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents volumes, network filesystems or any storage that survives container teardown. The citations cover only GPU selection, pricing, endpoints, sandboxes, observability and SDKs, so the verdict must be none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach persistent network storage that survives instance teardown, so datasets and checkpoints outlive any single GPU rental
